title: Cdiscount Product Scraper
description: Extract product listings from Cdiscount search pages. Provide a Cdiscount search URL directly or a keyword to generate one.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Cdiscount search URL to scrape. If empty, the actor builds one from the keyword.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Keyword used to build search URL when Start URL is empty.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of products
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of products to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum number of pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap for number of search pages to process.

includeSponsored.title: Include sponsored products
includeSponsored.description: Include sponsored brand offers when available.
